Senior Estimator | Construction

Australia, Queensland, Brisbane

Experience: 4-6 Years

Infrastructure

Introduction

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded estimator to take ownership of the estimating function, working on a diverse range of residential and commercial projects while contributing to the continued growth of the business.

What are you going to do

As the Senior Estimator, you will be responsible for preparing accurate estimates, managing supplier and subcontractor pricing, controlling project budgets, and supporting projects from pre-construction through to construction.

  • Prepare detailed cost estimates and quantity take-offs for residential projects.
  • Review plans, specifications and project documentation.
  • Source and negotiate competitive pricing from suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Prepare and manage project budgets.
  • Issue and manage purchase orders.
  • Monitor project costs and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Maintain estimating databases and current pricing.
  • Liaise with consultants, suppliers, subcontractors and internal project teams.
  • Support continuous improvement of estimating processes and procurement systems.

Essential skills and knowledge 

  • Minimum 5 years' experience as an Estimator within residential construction.
  • Strong knowledge of residential construction methods, materials and pricing.
  • Experience using estimating software such as Solo Assist, Databuild or similar.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and organisational skills.
  • High attention to detail and strong commercial acumen.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and work to deadlines.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary package.
  • Long-term career opportunity with a growing business.
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Opportunity to influence estimating systems and processes.
  • Diverse and rewarding residential construction projects.
  • Brisbane-based office with a stable pipeline of work.

If you're an experienced Senior Estimator looking to join a business that values quality, teamwork and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you.

About Brunel:

Brunel is a recruitment and flexible workforce solution provider which connects talented people with opportunities throughout Australasia and around the world. We specialise in highly skilled roles across a variety of technical, professional, trades and craft disciplines, pairing candidates with industry-leading projects and organisations on a contract, permanent or secondment basis.

Operating in Australasia since 1997, Brunel has major bases of operation in Perth, Sydney, Brisbane and Port Moresby, which are further backed by the strength and reach of a truly global network spanning over 45 countries, 120 offices and 45 years of successful operation.

Our Culture and Values

At Brunel, we are proud of our unique corporate culture, which is shaped and nurtured by the collective efforts of our employees. Our work environment is characterised by an authentic, communicative and inclusive approach to teamwork that fosters an atmosphere of collaboration and creativity. Our values are at the center of everything we do – for our clients, our colleagues and ourselves.

Our ESG Commitment

Since 1975, our mission has always been to connect specialists to exciting career opportunities, to support the development of these careers, and to offer fair and equal employment. This has enabled us to create a truly sustainable and durable business model. Having a passion for people and caring deeply for the environment is not only part of Brunel’s DNA but is also reflected in our culture and values. As a global company, we take our social responsibility very seriously.
